customManagers.description: Track the pinned shared-ui release that fetch-shared-ui.ts clones at build time. Bumps normally arrive from .github/workflows/shared-ui-bump.yml (triggered by every shared-ui release, with screenshots refreshed); Renovate is the safety net, see the jellyrock/shared-ui package rule.

packageRules.description: The browser tests run in the official Playwright image (.github/workflows/ci.yml), which must match the @playwright/test version or the test runner refuses to start. Group them so they always move in one PR. The image sits in a workflow file, so the org preset's GitHub Actions rule would otherwise give it a Monday-only schedule and split it from the npm package; schedule is reset here. A Playwright bump can change how pages render, so the screenshot tests may go red on it: refresh the baselines on that PR (README: Browser tests).

Safety net for shared-ui: the shared-ui-bump workflow opens and usually merges the bump within minutes of a release. Renovate only opens a PR if that has not landed within 3 days (internalChecksFilter strict: no PR while the release is younger than minimumReleaseAge), and never automerges it, because a shared-ui change usually changes screenshots that need refreshing (scripts/shared-ui-bump.sh does that).
